knowledge:
- key_parameters: distMethod=Specifies the distance metric in dfToDistance (e.g., "euclidean", Pearson's correlation, or "gower" for categorical features) ;; nComp=Number of reduced dimensions to extract in dfToProjection (typically 2) ;; nBins=Number of overlapping intervals/bins per dimension in mapperCore (e.g., 15 or 33) ;; overlap=Fraction of overlap between adjacent bins in mapperCore (e.g., 0.3 or 0.15) ;; clustMeth=Clustering algorithm applied to samples within each bin in mapperCore (e.g., "kmeans", "hierarchical clustering", "dbscan", or "optics") ;; method=Community detection algorithm in autoClusterMapper (e.g., "automatic", "walktrap", "fast-greedy", "edge-betweenness", "optimal", "label-propagation")
- alternatives: Standard external functions can be used for low-dimensional reduction (e.g., princomp) and distance calculation (e.g., dist) instead of dfToProjection and dfToDistance. Cytoscape (with aMatReader and clusterMaker2/GLay plugins) can be used as an alternative external tool for network visualization and community detection.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you want to perform unsupervised community mining on high-dimensional, heterogeneous datasets (such as single-cell RNA-seq, bulk transcriptomics, or clinical data) while preserving continuous topological relationships and identifying novel sub-populations or phenotypes.
- pitfalls: Very sparse networks with many isolated nodes may falsely appear scale-free; use the Product Score metric to simultaneously reward scale-free behavior and overall graph cohesion. Low expressed genes should be filtered and normalized (e.g., using DaMiRseq or standard Seurat workflows) before running PIUMA. Singletons (disconnected nodes) should be excluded from downstream biological interpretation as they lack structural relevance to the underlying geometry.

workflows.name: standard_tda_pipeline
workflows.intent: Perform a standard end-to-end Topological Data Analysis and community detection workflow on a normalized expression data frame or SummarizedExperiment.
input: df_TDA (data.frame containing normalized expression values and metadata columns)
dataSE (SummarizedExperiment object containing normalized assay data and colData metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize the TDAobj from a data frame or SummarizedExperiment ;; 2. Compute the distance matrix ;; 3. Project the data into a low-dimensional space (lens) ;; 4. Run the Mapper algorithm to partition data into overlapping nodes ;; 5. Calculate the Jaccard similarity matrix between nodes ;; 6. Perform node enrichment to average feature values per node ;; 7. Assess network topology and predict the graph geometry ;; 8. Perform geometry-guided community detection ;; 9. Export network files for Cytoscape visualization (optional)
workflows.code:
TDA_obj <- makeTDAobj(df_TDA, c("stage","zone"))
# Alternatively, from a SummarizedExperiment:
# TDA_obj <- makeTDAobjFromSE(dataSE, c("stage","zone"))

TDA_obj <- dfToDistance(TDA_obj, distMethod = "euclidean")

TDA_obj <- dfToProjection(TDA_obj, "UMAP", nComp = 2, umapNNeigh = 25, umapMinDist = 0.3, showPlot = FALSE)

TDA_obj <- mapperCore(TDA_obj, nBins = 15, overlap = 0.3, clustMeth = "kmeans")

TDA_obj <- jaccardMatrix(TDA_obj)

TDA_obj <- tdaDfEnrichment(TDA_obj, cbind(getScaledData(TDA_obj), getOutcome(TDA_obj)))

entropy <- checkNetEntropy(getNodeDataMat(TDA_obj)[, "zone"])
netModel <- checkScaleFreeModel(TDA_obj, showPlot = TRUE)

TDA_obj <- jaccardMatrix(TDA_obj)
TDA_obj <- setGraph(TDA_obj)
TDA_obj <- predict_mapper_class(TDA_obj, verbose = TRUE)

TDA_obj <- autoClusterMapper(TDA_obj,method = 'automatic')

# Optional: Export to Cytoscape
# write.table(x = round(getJacc(TDA_obj),3), file = "./jaccard.matrix.txt", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "", col.names = NA)
# write.table(x = getNodeDataMat(TDA_obj), file = "./nodeEnrichment.txt", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = NA)

workflows.name: seurat_integrated_tda
workflows.intent: Integrate PIUMA's geometry-informed TDA clustering into a standard Seurat single-cell RNA-seq workflow.
input: pbmc3k (Seurat object containing raw single-cell RNA-seq counts and metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocess the Seurat object (normalize, scale, find variable features, run PCA and UMAP) ;; 2. Convert the Seurat object into a SummarizedExperiment ;; 3. Initialize the TDAobj from the SummarizedExperiment ;; 4. Compute the distance matrix and import Seurat's UMAP coordinates as the projection lens ;; 5. Run the Mapper algorithm ;; 6. Calculate the Jaccard similarity matrix, set the graph, and predict the mapper class ;; 7. Perform community detection using a specified method (e.g., walktrap) ;; 8. Map the identified TDA clusters back to the Seurat object metadata for downstream analysis
workflows.code:
pbmc3k <- UpdateSeuratObject(pbmc3k)
pbmc3k <- NormalizeData(pbmc3k)
pbmc3k <- ScaleData(pbmc3k)
pbmc3k <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc3k)
pbmc3k <- RunPCA(pbmc3k)
pbmc3k <- RunUMAP(pbmc3k,dims = 1:20)

counts_mat <- pbmc3k@assays$RNA@layers$counts
logcounts_mat <- pbmc3k@assays$RNA@layers$data

colnames(counts_mat) <- rownames(pbmc3k@meta.data)
colnames(logcounts_mat) <- rownames(pbmc3k@meta.data)

rownames(counts_mat) <- rownames(pbmc3k@assays$RNA@features@.Data)
rownames(logcounts_mat) <- rownames(pbmc3k@assays$RNA@features@.Data)

counts_dense    <- as.matrix(counts_mat)
logcounts_dense <- as.matrix(logcounts_mat)
cell_meta     <- pbmc3k@meta.data

gene_meta     <- DataFrame(
  gene_id = rownames(counts_mat),
  row.names = rownames(counts_mat)
)

se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays   = list(
    counts    = counts_dense,
    logcounts = logcounts_dense
  ),
  colData = cell_meta,
  rowData = gene_meta
)

colData(se)$seurat_annotations <- factor(
  ifelse(
    is.na(colData(se)$seurat_annotations),
    "Unknown",
    as.character(colData(se)$seurat_annotations)
  )
)

tda_obj <- makeTDAobjFromSE(se,'seurat_annotations')

tda_obj <- dfToDistance(tda_obj, distMethod = "euclidean")
umap <- pbmc3k@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
colnames(umap) <- c('comp1','comp2')

tda_obj@comp <- as.data.frame(umap)

tda_obj <- mapperCore(x = tda_obj, nBins = 33, overlap = 0.15)
tda_obj <- jaccardMatrix(tda_obj)
tda_obj <- setGraph(tda_obj)
tda_obj <- predict_mapper_class(tda_obj)
tda_obj <- autoClusterMapper(tda_obj,method = 'walktrap')

clusters_piuma <- tda_obj@clustering$obs_cluster
all_cells     <- rownames(pbmc3k@meta.data)
piuma_clusters <- setNames(
  rep(NA_integer_, length(all_cells)),
  all_cells
)
piuma_clusters[ clusters_piuma$obs ] <- clusters_piuma$cluster
pbmc3k@meta.data$PIUMA_clusters <- as.factor(piuma_clusters)
